title: Coprocessor canary probe and metered sandbox for model trial runs
creator: Priya Patel
description: Implement a "coprocessor" parallel-execution probe that runs a sampled subset of live requests against candidate model variants in an isolated, metered sandbox. The probe must avoid impacting the production response path, enforce per-tenant and global cost caps, keep candidate outputs and logs segregated, and integrate signals into the rollout controller to enable automated rollback or sample-rate adjustments when regressions or cost anomalies are detected.
acceptance_criteria: Staging deployment where 0.5% and 5% sample rates can be toggled per-route
Observed production p95 latency overhead of primary path < 2ms with probing enabled (measured on benchmark workload)
Sandbox enforces per-tenant token-budget and global cost fence; exceeding budget immediately drops probe for affected tenants
Probe telemetry feeds into rollout controller: canary health score, drift metrics, cost burn rate; controller can cut sample rate to 0 and mark candidate unhealthy automatically
All probe data stored in encrypted, auditable logs separated from PII production logs; telemetry visible in Console under a new 'Trial Runs' dashboard
KV-cache warming option works: probe can pre-seed candidate runtime without exposing caches to primary path
Chaos test where probe runtime is killed repeatedly and primary path remains unaffected and healthy
technical_notes: Architecture: lightweight request router forks a minimal copy of request metadata and inputs to the coprocessor via an internal async channel; primary response uses existing runtime path and is never delayed by coprocessor failures

Sandbox runtime: constrained pods with no external egress, strict CPU/GPU quotas, per-pod token-bucket for billing control; filesystem mounts read-only; candidate model loaded into isolated memory space
Sampling controller: centralized policy service exposes dynamic sample rates per-route/tenant computed from recent quality delta and cost burn; API for manual override from Console
Cost enforcement: token-meter intercept counts estimated token-equivalents of coprocessor runs; a budget daemon subtracts from tenant credit and emits throttle decision if limit reached
Data handling: probe output persisted to a separate S3 prefix and ledger with object keys tagged by route, tenant, canary-id; logs encrypted with customer KMS when private tenants are used

Comparison tooling: differential scorer computes normalized edit-distance, semantic-similarity (embedding cosine), and safety-classifier disagreements; results are aggregated into canary health metrics
Rollback signal: when health score < configured threshold OR cost-burn exceeds configured multiple of baseline, the rollout controller will reduce sample rate to 0 and trigger the rollback runbook
Observability: add probes for probe-drop-rate, probe-latency-p95, probe-cost-per-minute, delta-agreement-rate; wire to tracing with same trace-id correlation but with a 'probe' span attribute
testing_plan: Unit tests for sampling controller logic and budget daemon
Integration test that launches candidate model in sandbox and validates no RPC/DB egress from sandbox
Performance test against production-like traffic to assert primary-path latency overhead <2ms p95
Cost-failure test: inject synthetic high-cost candidate that quickly burns budget; assert controller gates probe within 60s
Regression test for KV cache warm-up to ensure probe can pre-seed without affecting primary cache state
Security review including pen-test checklist for sandbox isolation and key handling
Runbook verification: simulate automatic rollback and ensure Console alerting + Slack notifications are emitted
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): enable probe on internal routes only, sample-rate 5%, run for 72 hours; validate metrics and storage
Phase 2 (canary): enable probe for 1% of traffic on low-risk tenant cohort; monitor for 7 days; configure auto-cut thresholds conservatively
Phase 3 (expanded): ramp sample-rate to up to 5% on selected routes with explicit business-owner signoff; enable cost fences per-tenant
Emergency rollback: rollout controller auto-cuts sample to 0 and triggers rollback runbook; ops executes manual rollback if automated path fails
